def test_decimal_formatting():
        """Verify values are formatted with 4 decimal places."""
        df = pd.read_csv('/app/output/results.csv')
    
        # Check that all values have at most 4 decimal places when rounded
        for col in ['time', 'population']:
            # Multiply by 10000 and check if values are close to integers
            scaled = df[col] * 10000
            is_close_to_int = np.all(np.abs(scaled - np.round(scaled)) < 1e-10)
